Sandbox_PhotonSword_BatteryLifeHours_too: How long a full battery keeps a blade ignited. 0 means blades never drain.
Sandbox_PhotonSword_DamageMultiplier_too: Scales an ignited blade's damage (base 11-15.4). Applies to blades ignited after the change.
Sandbox_PhotonSword_ExtinguishWhileRunni: Running or sprinting with a lit photon sword puts it out, and it relights when the run ends.
Sandbox_PhotonSword_CrystalSpawnChance_t: Chance a photon sword hilt found as loot already holds a photon crystal, in a random color. Hilts without one need a crystal fitted before they ignite; crystals are also found on their own, in jewelry stores and with the hilts.
Sandbox_PhotonSword_CutDoorsAndWindows_t: Swinging an ignited blade at a map door or window cuts it out, along with any barricade or curtains. Player-built ones follow Destroy Player-Built Objects.
Sandbox_PhotonSword_CutWalls_tooltip: Swinging an ignited blade at a map wall cuts it out. Player-built walls follow Destroy Player-Built Objects.
Sandbox_PhotonSword_CutVegetation_toolti: Swinging an ignited blade fells trees and clears bushes and tall grass on the player's square and the square in front, in one swing.
Sandbox_PhotonSword_CutWorldObjects_tool: Swinging an ignited blade cuts up map furniture, appliances, containers, and fences in front of the player, one per swing, using the same rules as a sledgehammer. Container contents drop on the floor. Floors are never cut.
Sandbox_PhotonSword_CutPlayerBuilt_toolt: Swinging an ignited blade cuts anything players have built: walls, doors, windows, furniture, and fences. Other players' safehouses are still protected.
Sandbox_PhotonSword_CutEffect_tooltip: What happens to something a swing cuts. Destroy removes it at once, like a sledgehammer. Set on Fire starts a fire instead: on the far side of a door, window, wall, or fence, or in the square in front for objects and vegetation. Fires burn and spread normally, so they can reach nearby objects and players.
Sandbox_PhotonSword_DeflectBullets_toolt: A raised guard can deflect bullets fired from in front of it. The guard is the ready stance (aiming the ignited sword in both hands), or with Photon Sword Forms a Form's raised block.
Sandbox_PhotonSword_DeflectChanceMin_too: Chance to deflect a bullet with no guard skill. It slides up to the full-skill chance as skill grows. Guard skill is the Long Blade level, or with Photon Sword Forms the Form's mastery and Martial Arts level.
Sandbox_PhotonSword_DeflectChanceMax_too: Chance to deflect a bullet at full guard skill. Guard skill is the Long Blade level, or with Photon Sword Forms the Form's mastery and Martial Arts level.
Sandbox_PhotonSword_DeflectStrikesBack_t: A deflected bullet goes back to whoever fired it: a bullet wound for a player, the weapon's hit for a zombie-based NPC such as a bandit. Off: the bullet is only stopped.
Sandbox_PhotonSword_SoakShotgunBlasts_to: A raised guard soaks part of a shotgun blast from in front of it. The guard is the ready stance (aiming the ignited sword in both hands), or with Photon Sword Forms a Form's raised block.
Sandbox_PhotonSword_SoakMin_tooltip: Share of a shotgun blast's damage the guard soaks with no guard skill. It slides up to the full-skill share as skill grows. Guard skill is the Long Blade level, or with Photon Sword Forms the Form's mastery and Martial Arts level.
Sandbox_PhotonSword_SoakMax_tooltip: Share of a shotgun blast's damage the guard soaks at full guard skill. Guard skill is the Long Blade level, or with Photon Sword Forms the Form's mastery and Martial Arts level.
Sandbox_PhotonSword_SoakFullChance: Whole Blast Blocked at Full Skill (%%)
Sandbox_PhotonSword_SoakFullChance_toolt: At full guard skill (Long Blade 10, or full Form mastery with Photon Sword Forms), the chance the guard takes a whole shotgun blast.
Sandbox_PhotonSword_BlockPhotonSwords_to: A raised guard can block a photon sword's strike from in front of it, a player's or an NPC's. With Photon Sword Forms, a Form's block holds against one while its guard meter can pay, and each block drains the meter.
Sandbox_PhotonSword_BlockChanceMin_toolt: Chance the ready stance blocks a photon sword's strike with no guard skill. It slides up to the full-skill chance as Long Blade grows. A Form's block (Photon Sword Forms) doesn't roll.
Sandbox_PhotonSword_BlockChanceMax_toolt: Chance the ready stance blocks a photon sword's strike at Long Blade 10.
Sandbox_PhotonSword_NpcBlockChance_toolt: Chance an NPC holding a photon sword (from the Bandits or Project A-Life patch) blocks a player's photon sword strike from in front of it. 0 means NPCs never block.
Sandbox_PhotonSword_NpcVsNpcBlockChance_: Chance an NPC holding a photon sword blocks another NPC's photon sword strike from in front of it. Kept lower than the NPC Block Chance so sword duels between NPCs end. 0 means NPCs never block each other.
